name: Otherworldly Acuity
body:
School divination; Level bard 5, cleric/oracle 5, psychic 5, ranger 4, sorcerer/wizard 6, witch 6

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components S

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 10 minutes/level

DESCRIPTION

You manifest the senses of a powerful outsider. You gain darkvision out to a range of 60 feet (or increase the range of your darkvision by 60 feet), and you can see in magical darkness as though it were regular darkness. In addition you can see invisible creatures and objects as well as creatures on the ethereal plane.
